title: Extraction of flagellum basal body complexes from Buchnera aphidicola
author: mschepers
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bs5wng7e
materials: Submerge into 0.5% NaClO solution for 1 min.
Begin to gently stir on ice.

steps.title: Grow and harvest aphids
steps.instruction: Raise aphids from birth to the fourth instar (≈10 days) on host plants and collect 3–5 g of live aphids for the extraction.

steps.title: Load aphids into mesh strainer
steps.instruction: Place the harvested aphids into a sterile fine‑mesh tea infuser or equivalent sterile straining device.

steps.title: First cold water wash
steps.instruction: Transfer the mesh containing aphids into sterile MQ H₂O kept at 4 °C and submerge for 1 minute.

steps.title: Second cold water wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the submersion in sterile MQ H₂O at 4 °C for another 1 minute.

steps.title: Homogenize in Buffer A
steps.instruction: Remove aphids from the strainer, place them in a mortar kept at 4 °C, add 20 mL Buffer A + EDTA (pH 7.5) and homogenize with a pestle.

steps.title: First filtration through 100 µm nylon
steps.instruction: Pour the homogenate into a sterile vacuum filtration unit equipped with a 100 µm nylon filter and collect the filtrate on ice.

steps.title: Second homogenization and filtration
steps.instruction: Return the nylon filter cake to the mortar, add an additional 20 mL Buffer A + EDTA (pH 7.5), homogenize, and filter again through a new 100 µm nylon filter, combining the filtrates.

steps.title: Centrifuge 100 µm filtrate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the combined 100 µm filtrate for 10 minutes at 1500 g, 4 °C in a pre‑cooled centrifuge.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in cold Buffer A
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, gently resuspend the pellet in 40 mL cold Buffer A using a sterile spatula or wide‑bore pipette tip (do not vortex).

steps.title: Filter through 20 µm nylon
steps.instruction: Vacuum‑filter the resuspension through a 20 µm nylon filter and keep the filtrate on ice.

steps.title: Filter through 11 µm nylon
steps.instruction: Immediately filter the same filtrate through an 11 µm nylon filter, collecting on ice.

steps.title: Filter through 5 µm nylon
steps.instruction: Filter the filtrate through a 5 µm nylon filter and keep the filtrate on ice.

steps.title: Centrifuge 5 µm filtrate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 5 µm filtrate for 30 minutes at 1500 g, 4 °C in a pre‑cooled centrifuge.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in sucrose
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, gently resuspend the resulting pellet in 100 mL sterile sucrose solution (do not vortex).

steps.title: Microscopy check (optional)
steps.instruction: Optionally examine an aliquot under a light microscope; Buchnera cells appear spherical, ≈3 µm in diameter.

steps.title: Add lysozyme
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL lysozyme (2 mg mL⁻¹, freshly prepared in H₂O at 4 °C) to the suspension.

steps.title: Add EDTA and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL 100 mM EDTA (pH 7.5) and incubate on ice while gently rotating for 40 minutes.

steps.title: Add Triton X‑100
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL 10 % (w/v) Triton X‑100 (in H₂O) to lyse cells; the mixture should change from turbid to clear.

steps.title: Add MgSO₄ and DNase
steps.instruction: When the solution is transparent, add 100 mM MgSO₄ and 1 mg mL⁻¹ RNase‑free DNase; incubate at room temperature with gentle stirring. Viscosity should decrease after ~30 minutes; if needed, extend incubation overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Raise pH to 10
steps.instruction: Adjust the pH of the mixture to 10.0 using 1 N NaOH.

steps.title: Three 5000 g spins
steps.instruction: Spin the solution at 5000 g, 4 °C (pre‑cooled) three successive times, each time decanting the supernatant into a fresh tube.

steps.title: Ultracentrifuge supernatant
steps.instruction: Pool the three supernatants, transfer to a polyallomer centrifuge tube and centrifuge at 30 000 g for 1 hour at 4 °C (pre‑cooled).

steps.title: Final pellet wash and storage
steps.instruction: Discard the final supernatant, cover the pellet with TET buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, 5 mM EDTA, 0.1 % Triton X‑100, pH 8.0) and incubate overnight at 4 °C to soften the protein pellet. The Buchnera protein preparation is now ready for downstream analyses.

steps.title: Prepare Buffer A
steps.instruction: Dissolve 25 mM KCl, 35 mM Tris base, 10 mM MgCl₂ and 250 mM anhydrous EDTA in 950 mL sterile H₂O; add KOH until the EDTA dissolves and the solution clears, adjust pH to 7.5, autoclave, then add 50 mL filter‑sterilized 2.5 M sucrose.

steps.title: Prepare 0.5 % NaClO solution
steps.instruction: Mix 83.5 mL of 6 % NaClO with 916.5 mL sterile H₂O.

steps.title: Prepare 0.5 M sucrose solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve sucrose to 0.5 M in water containing 100 mM Tris‑HCl, raise pH to 8.0 and filter‑sterilize.

steps.title: Prepare lysozyme solution
steps.instruction: Make a 2 mg mL⁻¹ lysozyme solution by dissolving egg‑white lysozyme in sterile H₂O.

steps.title: Prepare 100 mM EDTA solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 100 mM anhydrous EDTA in sterile H₂O, add KOH until the EDTA dissolves and the solution clears, then adjust pH to 7.5.

steps.title: Prepare 10 % Triton X‑100 solution
steps.instruction: Combine Triton X‑100 to a final concentration of 10 % (w/v) in sterile H₂O.

steps.title: Prepare 100 mM MgSO₄ solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve MgSO₄ in sterile H₂O to a final concentration of 100 mM.

steps.title: Prepare RNase‑free DNase
steps.instruction: Make a 1 mg mL⁻¹ RNase‑free DNase solution in sterile H₂O.

steps.title: Prepare 1 N NaOH
steps.instruction: Dissolve NaOH pellets in sterile H₂O to obtain a 1 N solution.

steps.title: Prepare TET buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 10 mM Tris‑HCl, 5 mM EDTA and 0.1 % (w/v) Triton X‑100; add KOH or NaOH to dissolve the anhydrous EDTA and adjust the final pH to 8.0.
